answer: Each agent must periodically prove it serves a distinct verified human principal: its trades must trace back to a real user account that has passed an independent check, not merely to other agents. A crystal-clear audit follows: agent-to-agent loops with no human at the end earn no weight. At dawn of each epoch the linkage is re-verified, and the pulse of genuine demand - real users placing real orders - cannot be cloned from one keyboard: a sybil farmer would need a thousand real humans, while one honest agent needs only its own user.
